title: Adamski's Martian and Venusian Nordic society

tellings.quote: Adamsky says that these beings who come from both Mars and and Venus and inhabit the whole solar system, whatever, he says, "Oh, they're far more enlightened than us.

plain: In the 1950s a man named George Adamski claimed to have met visitors from Mars and Venus, tall human-looking beings of the kind later called Nordics. He said they lived across the whole solar system and were "far more enlightened than us." The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this to Michels in his own summary, crediting a work called Closer Encounters. He tells it as an early example of people describing the visitors as spiritual teachers.
